desc:
Panda is a wandering fighter from The Last Rebel (TLR), our own original universe, where Tiger leads the cast. A straw hat, prayer beads, a gourd-tipped staff and patched leather give him a monk-on-the-road feel, and his round, heavy build makes him read differently from everyone else in the lineup.

The sculpt keeps the soft volumes of a panda while layering on metal plates, rope, beads and torn cloth, each with its own wear. Like the rest of the TLR cast, he's built for Unreal Engine: channel-packed mask maps drive a master shader, so colors, wear and emissive accents can be changed in engine without re-texturing.

Building a cast of creature heroes with real personality? We'll build yours to your style, budget and platform.
textures: Channel-packed mask maps, six 4K and two 2K texture sets
software: ZBrush, Maya, Substance Painter, Unreal Engine
